summary_text:
LEGAL SUMMARY (EVIDENCE-CONSTRUED, STRICTLY BASED ON SUPPLIED EVIDENCE):

1. The case is listed as C.C. No. 132 of 1998, heard in the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Chinnur, on Monday, the 15th day of September, 2014.

2. The complainant is Smt. Lambu Anantha Devi, identified as PW-1. Kumri Lambu Radhika is the daughter of the complainant and is also a witness (LW-3).

3. The Circle Inspector of Police, Mancherial, filed a charge sheet against accused persons A-1 to A-10 in Cr. No. 37/1993 of P.S. Jaipur, under sections 147, 148, and 427 read with section 149 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC).

4. The charge sheet alleges offences committed against Smt. Lambu Anantha Devi, with the accused persons being:
   - A-1: Satwaji @ Sudhakaranna
   - A-2: Golla Rajam
   - A-3: Parasaboina Rajam @ Naganna
   - A-5: Arigela Venka Goud @ Pratap
   - A-6: Gaddam Rajam @ Yadanna
   - A-7: Ganganna @ Mallesh
   - A-8: Radhakka
   - A-9: Rayaposham @ Kishan
   - A-10: Bomgoni Komura Goud (died on 16.9.1993 in Cr. No. 83/1993 of P.S. Jaipur)

5. The case against A-1 to A-7 and A-9 to A-10 was split and renumbered as C.C. No. 47 of 2014.

6. A-8 (Radhakka) is currently in judicial
